prompt_md: A doctor gives you 3 pills and tells you to take one every half hour, starting with one right now. How many minutes until you've taken them all?
prompt_short: 3 pills, one every half hour, first one now. Minutes until all are taken?
explain_intuition_md: You take the first pill straight away, the second at 30 minutes and the third at 60. Three pills only need two half-hour gaps.
